operating_notes.text: Received ₹18.88 Cr order (incl. GST) from Ram Taranga Solutions for power and inverter duty transformers to be executed in 6 months.
Received PGCIL approval as a registered vendor for supply of power transformers up to 132kV.
Marsons received a ₹29.85 Cr (USD 3.1 million) purchase order from a US-based solar energy developer for a 200 MVA 115 kV Power Transformer in Alabama, USA, to be executed in over 12 months.
Annual manufacturing capacity increased from 12,000 MVA to 26,000 MVA following approval for 400 kV/500 MVA class power transformers.

LoI worth ₹31.27 Cr (incl. GST) from Assam Electricity Grid Corporation for 132/33kV, 50MVA power transformers and related services at Durlavcherra, Karimganj & Srikona substations (Package-T-3), to be executed in 12 months.

timeline.summary: Marsons received a ₹18.88 Cr order from Ram Taranga Solutions for power and inverter duty transformers.
Marsons received PGCIL vendor approval for supplying transformers up to 132kV in POWERGRID projects.
Marsons received PGCIL vendor approval for supplying power transformers across Eastern India and ten neighbouring states.
Marsons received an international export order worth ₹29.85 Cr (USD 3.1 million) from a US-based solar energy developer for a power transformer.
Marsons reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹92.26 Cr and PAT of ₹22.58 Cr, and approved capacity expansion to 26,000 MVA.
Marsons received a ₹31.27 Cr (incl. GST) letter of intent from Assam Electricity Grid Corporation for 132/33kV, 50MVA transformers at three substations, to be executed in 12 months.
